items.title: Chuck Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 7, 2023
items.q: this record I did with Harvey Sorgen and Jay Anderson, you know you go in you play, you record it

ctx.x: I know but you almost, it just feels like you should.

You know what I mean? You know? I want the thing. I love this you know, oh man this was great, but at least a CD and oh man, it’s just something you can pick up. And sell a lot of them on gigs you know so that’s like, so we’re doing a CD release party on May 19th at Caffe Lena for her. And you know she’s doing it in a more music-industry way. She’s going to release singles. That’s the thing you do. You do a promo thing, you do push, you release a single this month and next month and that’s a whole different world…
Well, Chuck, this has been a long time coming.
